description: This file contains unit tests for CancellationToken functionality within the Orleans framework, specifically testing cancellation propagation, acknowledgement, and interactions across grains and silos.

classes.name: CancellationTokenTests_WaitForAcknowledgement
classes.description: Derived test class that sets WaitForCancellationAcknowledgement to true, testing cancellation acknowledgment waiting behavior.

classes.name: CancellationTokenTests_NoWaitForAcknowledgement
classes.description: Derived test class that sets WaitForCancellationAcknowledgement to false, testing cancellation behavior without acknowledgment wait.

classes.name: CancellationTokenTests
classes.description: Abstract base class containing various tests for CancellationToken propagation, cancellation handling, and cross-silo behavior in Orleans grains.

methods.name: GrainTaskCancellation

methods.name: MultipleGrainsTaskCancellation
methods.description: Tests cancellation of multiple grain tasks grouped together.

methods.name: GrainTaskMultipleCancellations
methods.description: Tests handling multiple cancellation requests for a single grain.

methods.name: TokenPassingWithoutCancellation_NoExceptionShouldBeThrown
methods.description: Ensures that passing an uncanceled token does not throw exceptions.

methods.name: PreCancelledTokenPassing
methods.description: Checks behavior when passing a token that is already canceled.

methods.name: CancellationTokenCallbacksExecutionContext
methods.description: Verifies correct execution of cancellation callbacks and acknowledgment.

methods.name: CancellationTokenCallbacksTaskSchedulerContext
methods.description: Verifies correct execution context for cancellation callbacks scheduled on task schedulers.

methods.name: CancellationTokenCallbacksThrow_ExceptionDoesNotPropagate

methods.name: InterSiloCancellation
methods.description: Tests cancellation across different silo environments.

methods.description: Tests passing cancellation tokens between clients and silos across silos.
